It all started when I was only 9... The doctor thought I had add... So he gave me 20 mg of Adderall in the morning and 10 at noon... I never took my pills so I accumulated about 25 bottles by the time I was 12 or 13... When I was 14 me and my friend discovered Adderall was a wonder drug.. I started snorting about 2 every day... I ended up in rehab.. Instead of Adderall I lived off the music of modest mouse and the velvet underground... Now I'm 16... All my pills are gone but I still have the craving.. My friend offered me 6 20s for 10 bucks.. I did it in a heard beat.. Now I'm sittin in front of my computer its about 430.. I just snorted 2.. I have a slight head buzz but the full effects havent kicked in yet... But I dont plan on sleeping
Now its about 2 oclock.. I just snorted another 20.. Just 2 keep my buzz going..
Now its about 1030 the next day.. I'm starving but cant seem 2 eat.. And I'm exhausted but cant seem 2 sleep... The come down is worse then any other drug I've ever done.. Besides x of course... But its worth it.. The rush is the best thing that ever happened to me.. I think I'm doomed to be an addict for a while...
I know I made it sound amazing.. But its not worth it.. If the doctors diddnt give me this shit when I was a kid... Id be fine ... O well for now I'm just gunna nullify my life
